item.title: Mini brain organoids ‘reading’ Braille key step towards biohybrid computing
item.description:
📝 The brain organoids, remotely connected to a sensor that recorded tactile signals from different Braille letters, produced signals that were different for each letter, allowing a decoder to distinguish between the different letters the organoids had been given. Could computers include tiny brain organoids one day. They found that teams of three brain organoids produced signals which accurately corresponded to different letters 83% of the time.
🔗 Read more: https://www.frontiersin.org/news/2026/10/16/mini-brain-organoids-reading-braille-biohybrid-computing-frontiers-artificial-intelligence
